label.description: The visible label, which also names the area. Without one, the area needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.

value.description: The area's color, when the caller controls it. The area edits its saturation and brightness and keeps the hue.

defaultValue.description: The starting color, when the area controls itself.

disabled.description: Disables the area: it can be neither focused nor changed. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

readOnly.description: Makes the area read-only: it stays focusable but its color cannot be changed. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

change.description: Called with the new color as a CSS string each time saturation or brightness changes, in the color space of the value, of the enclosing ColorPicker, or of defaultValue, and in rgba() form with none of them. A disabled or read-only area does not call it.

MuxUIColorValue.description: A CSS color string. A color control's onChange returns one in the color space of its value, of an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or of its defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and rgb, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for hsl and hsb. ColorSlider with colorSpace uses that space, and ColorSwatchPicker returns the chosen item's color.
